analysis:
Examined both revisions, patches and file metadata across all supplied units. ClusterPublicModels.swift:47-62 validates assistant policy, requires singleton verification and syntactically bounded evidence identity, and supplies depth/inventory/verification/evidence fields for hashing. Artifact and tensor-family matching at :151-157 restrict assistant lookup. Both production declarations still omit assistants (:90-97), so these changes alone activate no public assistant. The task-local declaration override (:143-145) is internal; no product setter is supplied.
DistributedInstalledNativeStart.swift:32-40 adds those fields to the resource-policy digest, used by plan registration (:47-50) and native authorization (:77); canonical-common comparison remains enforced (:94-99). Without an assistant the digest is unchanged. DistributedInstalledPairServingGrant.swift head patch :673-678 changes public-traffic messaging to waive the assistant warning only when an artifact-matched declaration exists; this is not itself authorization. Surrounding base source describes independent coordinator approval and placement parity requirements.
No concrete regression is established here. Relevant contracts are T-007/T-027 output and artifact integrity, T-052/T-053/T-054 authorization and qualification binding, and T-056 limits of attested identity. Integration must verify ClusterConfiguration.validate requires the exact declared assistant and worker launch arguments match it: the new digest commits the declaration, not directly the saved configuration. Also examine ClusterRuntimeApprovalFacts and declarationOverride setters to confirm approval/start consistency and test-only overrides. These implementations are outside supplied coverage, not observed missing controls. No supplied change touches prompt encryption, tokens, billing, cache isolation (T-041), media storage, or privileged/local add-on boundaries.
